# BPMN Desk 0.2.0

- Visual BPMN 2.0 editing, Flowable properties, custom attributes and extension XML.
- Tabs, undo/redo, draft recovery and external file change detection.
- XML search and element navigation, English/Russian, light/dark themes, zoom and SVG export.
- Five licensed examples and optional local test packs.

AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` were built in GitHub Actions. [Validation](https://github.com/michaelbrylevskii/bpmn-desk/blob/v0.2.0/docs/validation.md).

Visual editing requires BPMN DI. Processes are not executed. Windows executables are unsigned; macOS is not available.
